ns2:section.sectionText: This section is restricted to Graduate students only. This course is restricted to MSPE students until Friday, May 8th, 2015. This course studies a variety of topics related to money, banking, and financial markets. In particular, it provides an introduction to money and its role in the economy, bond market and interest rates, stock market and other financial assets, exchange rate, banks and regulation on banking industry, money supply process and monetary policy.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Restricted to MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC.
